scope: Binary64 minimax discovery on a sixth-only 2,106-row design: all 1,461 complete second/fourth rows and 645 sixth-order rows, with no eighth-order rows. If the rationalized dual is Arb-certified, its lower bound will apply to the complete sixth-order objective for this fixed 162-column pool because all 645 sixth rows are members of the complete 63,133-orbit domain. This transcript alone is not a theorem.
